VALID-LOWER-BOUND: he also wins the event-specific DCC interaction against the defensive barrier. Identity firewall: this record belongs to the source-named High Lord Kaelen of the Vanguard . PLCT (Prediction-Lock Counter-Targeting): satisfy PLE by directly attacking the prediction/lock's production or persistence mechanism rather than by merely choosing a supposedly unpredicted action within the same model. Absolute crossscale VALID: Kaelen satisfies PLE-1 and PLCT against the named Omni-Prediction Field. The bridge is explicit: the source says his Superhax bypasses Ophidion's body and directly attacks the field, after which that Hax is dismantled. Relative crossscale VALID: Kaelen's demonstrated effect-layer counter defeats Ophidion's demonstrated prediction-lock architecture in this encounter. This is not equivalent to proving Kaelen is faster than every possible timeline, nor does it rank him above every predictor in fiction. Metarelative crossscale Ophidion's relation is neural state → prediction → static future-lock → preemptive nullification . Kaelen changes the contest to prediction effect → production/persistence targeted → field dismantled → ordinary combat resumes . The victory is a countermodel-over-governance relation, not a speed race inside the original model. Kaelen's post-injury “infinitely faster and stronger than when the fight began” supports a source-relative selfgap but is not converted into a universal numeric multiplier. The battle does not close the identity relation between this High Lord Kaelen and other Kaelen referents. Verdict and FID Overall verdict: VALID for PLE-1/PLCT and the event outcome; PROVISIONAL for mathematical sizing of the prediction space; INVALID for “speed beyond all futures” as the reason for victory. It does not force them into one scalar “power level.” Canon boundary: Zero-to-Certain Contact Counter (ZCC-1) , Finite-Time Infinite-Distance Traversal (FTIDT) and the Qintara–Vaelstrum Resolution Totalizer are crossscale-only analytical constructs. The source then states that she moves with Divine-Agility and “crosses the infinite void between them in a microsecond.” A singularity wound is healed/adapted from in less than a nanosecond, and Qintara later defeats Vaelstrum through Divine-Strength/overcostedness pressure. It is satisfied on the literal metric reading of “infinite void” and “crosses ... in a microsecond.” Relative crossscale ZCC-1: Qintara's counterrelation defeats Vaelstrum's demonstrated guaranteed-miss architecture. FTIDT: under matching path-traversal semantics, the event exceeds an external one-microsecond movement benchmark whose traversable distance remains finite. This result is movement-domain only; it does not automatically set reaction, cognition or attack speed. Metarelative crossscale attempted strike → retroactive miss is transformed into attempted strike → guaranteed contact . Separately, infinite separation → inaccessible under finite-distance traversal is source-stated as infinite separation → crossed within 1 μs . These are distinct relation-shifts. Vaelstrum's ability to digest timelines of entire multiverses is a capability statement. It does not automatically establish passive durability of equal scope. Canon boundary: Dead-Destiny Reversal Chain (DDRC) and Dalroemar Reversal Totalizer (DRT D ) are external analytical shorthand. They are not native Arthratan powers, titles, objects or cosmological tiers. Validity-gate record Subject Rhayhara . Stat/domain Outcome-reversal progression; adaptive survival; contest control; overcostedness/resource sustainability; pararetroactive Bloodline-Blessing progression. Not one raw-AP statistic. Native canonical event Sessions 1–5 of the Dalroemar sequence: Calamity threat-definition, first non-loss, second-encounter pushback, third-encounter submission, then repeated fully serious training victories. Source mode EXPLICIT CANON STATEMENT for Dalroemar's dead-destiny threat-definition; ACTUAL EVENT for Rhayhara's three escalating encounters and stated repeated later victories. Exact evidence URL Zubaida reader 19f19b822cb7e8bd · plain-text primary source . Prime/current/historical status Completed positive historical featcore and Prime-Apex-compatible lower bound. The transmission itself states that its Bloodline Blessing consequences are pararetroactive. This record does not infer that every unrelated present bodily statistic equals every historical maximum. Solo / joint / system attribution Rhayhara is the challenged combatant. Dalroemar is Veyndarion-codified. The second encounter explicitly uses Akesi Synergy with Rhayhara's own recursive adaptations; that local mechanism is therefore not re-described as isolated raw strength. Reader-facing Myth Rhayhara vs Dalroemar: Shattering the Dead-Destiny Boundary . External benchmark definition Define DDRC-k as a source-proved sequence in which a subject progressively improves its relation to the same adversarial condition or opponent across k outcome-states. Each rung must be directly evidenced; rhetorical threat-titles alone do not count. Rung Native relation Source-established result DDRC-1 Dalroemar fully releases a state defined as functionally unavoidable loss; the first clash is framed as 0% survival / certain loss. Rhayhara survives by the skin of her teeth and explicitly does not lose. DDRC-2 Dalroemar becomes even more serious and his hyperpotential growth exceeds the first battle. Rhayhara no longer merely survives; she actively pushes him back while her recursive adaptations counter the growth. DDRC-3 Dalroemar deploys every fractal level of his metacreatable hypervysals and tries to preserve the rule that fighting him cannot become easier. Rhayhara forces his transadaptive growth into an unsustainable negative differential and wins genuine submission. DDRC-4 A fully serious Dalroemar is reused as a recurring training opponent. The source states repeated sequential victories and continuing permanent/pararetroactive improvement. Absolute crossscale VALID-LOWER-BOUND: Rhayhara satisfies DDRC-4 for the exact progression above. The absolute result is outcome-control depth across a same-opponent escalation sequence, not a numerical size for “dead destiny.” Relative crossscale VALID: the source establishes a strict qualitative progression in Rhayhara's contest relation to Dalroemar: first-state Rhayhara achieves non-loss; later Rhayhara actively pushes back a more serious Dalroemar; later still she forces genuine submission; subsequent encounters become repeated victories. This licenses R3 contest-control > R2 contest-control > R1 contest-control on the Dalroemar matchup relation. It does not automatically rank every unrelated stat. Metarelative crossscale VALID: the strongest relation-over-relation structure is certain-loss condition → non-loss → causal-attribution rewrite → stronger rematch → pushback → higher rewrite → full adaptive contest → cost-collapse/submission → recurring training victories . The progression is evidentially stronger than reducing all sessions to “Rhayhara hit harder,” because the decisive predicate moves from survival to pressure-control to opponent-system sustainability. Hyperrelative crossscale Define DRT D as a single representational referent containing exactly the four proved DDRC rungs, the stated pararetroactive transitions between them, and the same-opponent continuity. VALID-LOWER-BOUND: Rhayhara can be represented as operating across/completing DRT D because each component is directly sourced. DRT D compresses the sequence; it does not create an additional victory, a universal destiny-negation power or a larger infinity. Exact bridgeproof The external criterion and native evidence share the same property: change in outcome-control against a continuously identifiable opponent/condition. Session 2 establishes non-loss under the dead-destiny condition. Session 3 explicitly says Rhayhara actively pushes Dalroemar back. Session 4 says she forces genuine submission by making his adaptive growth unsustainable. Session 5 states repeated fully serious victories. No crossstat substitution is required. Assumptions “0% probability of survival,” “mathematical certainty” and “functionally impossible to not lose” are retained as native threat-language and used only to type the source's intended outcome-condition. They are not converted into an external probability theorem applying to every possible formal model. The same Dalroemar identity persists through the repeated sequence as the source presents it. Pararetroactive Bloodline Blessings preserve the named causal-attribution improvements; they do not automatically rewrite every unrelated physical statistic or external event. The source's cost-based third-encounter victory supports overcostedness/resource-sustainability dominance in that contest, not a universal claim that Rhayhara's raw energy reserve exceeds Dalroemar's. Strongest skeptical objections Title Literalism: “Calamity to All” is an epithet, not a self-executing universal quantifier over every fictional or external entity. Dead-destiny inflation: defeating a source-defined certain-loss condition proves reversal of that canon condition; it does not automatically equal author-level control, omnipotence, or superiority to every external fate system. Open Recursion ≠ Completed Infinity: Session 5 says the ladder continues “recursively without limit.” This licenses a nonterminal recurrence rule, not completion of an actually infinite number of fights. Statdomain: progression from survival to submission establishes stronger matchup/contest control. Exact speed, durability, intelligence and AP ratios remain unproved unless separately bridged. Verdict and FID Overall verdict: VALID-LOWER-BOUND . Strong for same-opponent outcome-reversal depth and pararetroactive progression; invalid if rewritten as a single untyped “infinite AP” tier. FID sentence: Against Dalroemar, Rhayhara progresses from surviving a source-defined certain-loss state, to pushing back a more serious rematch, to forcing genuine submission by making his transadaptive growth unsustainable, then repeatedly defeating his fully serious state as training.
